command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '@@ BOOT_START'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_START'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
for event in power/device_pm_callback_start power/device_pm_callback_end power/suspend_resume rpm/rpm_resume rpm/rpm_suspend rpm/rpm_return_int; do
 echo "@@ FORMAT $event"
 f=/sys/kernel/debug/tracing/events/$event/format
 [ -f "$f" ] || exit 70
 cat "$f"
 echo '@@ END_FORMAT'
done
echo '@@ GLOBAL_TRACE_STATE'
cat /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/tracing_on /sys/kernel/debug/tracing/current_tracer
echo '@@ BOOT_END'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
echo '@@ TIME_END'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Read six exact existing PM/RPM tracepoint format files and globaltracebaseline; no trace enable/disable, no display control/callback/load. Physical panel unobserved.
